description: This file contains helper functions for managing plugins, hooks, and configurations in the openclaw project, including resolving file paths, applying slot selections, creating loggers, enabling hooks, extracting package names, formatting errors, and handling fallback decisions.

methods.name: resolveFileNpmSpecToLocalPath
methods.description: Resolves a file: URL string to a local path, handling different URL formats and errors.

methods.name: applySlotSelectionForPlugin
methods.description: Applies slot selection to a plugin based on its ID within the current configuration report.

methods.name: createPluginInstallLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger object with info and warn methods for plugin installation logs.

methods.name: createHookPackInstallLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger object with info and warn methods for hook pack installation logs.

methods.name: enableInternalHookEntries
methods.description: Enables internal hooks specified by their names in the configuration.

methods.name: extractInstalledNpmPackageName
methods.description: Extracts the npm package name from a plugin install record.

methods.name: extractInstalledNpmHookPackageName
methods.description: Extracts the npm package name from a hook install record.

methods.name: formatPluginInstallWithHookFallbackError
methods.description: Formats an error message combining plugin and hook errors.

methods.name: logHookPackRestartHint
methods.description: Logs a message indicating that a restart is needed to load hooks.

methods.name: logSlotWarnings
methods.description: Logs warnings related to slot selection.

methods.name: buildPreferredClawHubSpec
methods.description: Builds a preferred ClawHub specification string from a raw input.

methods.name: decidePreferredClawHubFallback
methods.description: Decides fallback behavior for ClawHub installation based on error codes.
